clue.text: Cancer subject has inner resistance?

indicators.note: the subject word holds the next piece within it, as something with an inner part

parts.note: a subject of discussion is a topic
R is the physics symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A question of whether the disease Cancer is a topic with built-in resistance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cancer' looks like the disease, but it is the line of latitude, the Tropic of Cancer.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tropic of Cancer is one of the two latitude lines bounding the tropics, so Cancer names one such line.

clue.text: See 23
Pet playing with quarry blocks

indicators.note: playing about with letters, like a toy, rearranges them

explanation.surface: A pet animal frolics around a quarry full of stone blocks.
explanation.definitionFit: Parquetry is flooring made of wooden blocks laid in a pattern, so blocks describes it by its material.

clue.text: Film star's detective partner

definitions.meaning: James ..., the Hollywood actor of gangster films
Christine ... partnered Mary Beth Lacey in the TV police drama ... & Lacey

explanation.surface: A movie actor has a sidekick who is a detective.
explanation.definitionFit: The surname belongs both to the actor James and to the TV detective who partnered Lacey.

clue.text: As it was written by King: 'head disorder'

parts.note: sic is the Latin note meaning thus, marking a quotation reproduced exactly as written
K is the chess abbreviation for king
a ness is a headland, a head of land jutting into the sea

explanation.surface: A quotation from Stephen King's writing describes a mental disorder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'King' suggests the novelist, but it just gives K.
explanation.definitionFit: Sickness and disorder are both general words for an illness or ailment of the body or mind.

clue.text: Investigating MPs 'southern elite', pledge support

parts.note: the elect are a chosen elite
to commit is to pledge or bind oneself
a tee is the peg supporting a golf ball

explanation.surface: Members of Parliament under investigation are a southern elite who promise support.
explanation.definitionFit: A select committee is a small group of members of Parliament appointed to investigate a particular matter.

clue.text: Grain medium implanted in eye covering (large)

indicators.note: one piece is set within the eye covering, as a lens might be implanted

parts.note: the cornea is the transparent covering at the front of the eye
M is the clothing-size abbreviation for medium
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: Something of medium size has been implanted in a large eye covering, like eye surgery.
explanation.definitionFit: Cornmeal is maize ground into coarse flour, a grain foodstuff, so grain stands for it loosely.

clue.text: Present time, or one time after noon?

indicators.note: the one-time word comes after the letter for noon in the answer

parts.note: once means on one occasion

explanation.surface: Asking whether it is now, or some moment in the afternoon.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase for the nonce means for the present occasion, so the word itself names the present time.

clue.text: Easter treat, consisting of lime mixed with cold nitrogen and steeped in a sort of wine

indicators.note: the mixed letters soak inside the wine word, as fruit is steeped in liquor

parts.note: sake is Japanese rice wine

indicators.note: lime is mixed together with the other letters, all stirred into a new order

parts.note: C is the tap abbreviation for cold and N the chemical symbol for nitrogen

explanation.surface: A recipe for an Easter cake made of lime with cold nitrogen soaked in wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Simnel cake is a fruit cake with marzipan traditionally eaten in Britain at Easter.

clue.text: Cross put against capital Latin vocal composition

parts.note: cross means angry, as does mad
Riga is the capital of Latvia

explanation.surface: A cross set beside a capital letter in a Latin choral piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cross' looks like a noun marking something, but it is the adjective meaning angry.
explanation.definitionFit: A madrigal is a part-song for unaccompanied voices, a kind of vocal composition.

clue.text: Repair men are to attach a new handle

indicators.note: repairing puts the letters back together in a new order

explanation.surface: Repairmen are coming to fit a new handle on something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'handle' is slang for a name, not a door handle.
explanation.definitionFit: Handle is informal for a name, so attaching a new one is giving something a different name.

clue.text: Free, one Parisian figured, to be injected with drug

parts.note: une is French for one, the feminine form

indicators.note: the figured word receives the drug inside it, as by a needle

parts.note: numbered means figured or counted
C is slang shorthand for cocaine

explanation.surface: A Frenchwoman, now free, worked out she would be injected with a drug.
explanation.definitionFit: Unencumbered means not weighed down or burdened, hence free.

clue.text: Model, carrying gator, swanning round part of Brazil

indicators.note: the model holds the scrambled reptile within her

parts.note: Kate Moss is a famous supermodel

indicators.note: swanning about is wandering aimlessly, so the letters move around

parts.note: O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A fashion model with an alligator swans around a region of Brazil.
explanation.definitionFit: Mato Grosso is a large state in western Brazil.

clue.text: Seafarer and lackey forced to accept it's American capital

parts.note: an old salt is an experienced sailor

indicators.note: the lackey takes the other word inside it
forced into a new shape, the letters are rearranged

parts.note: it's gives IT, the apostrophe-s being only the link

explanation.surface: A sailor and his servant are made to accept the American capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Salt Lake City is the state capital of Utah, a capital city in America.

clue.text: To recover from cold, possibly act stern

parts.note: C is the tap abbreviation for cold
an act of Parliament is one example of a law
the stern is the back of a ship

explanation.surface: Advice to get over a cold by acting strictly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stern' looks like an adjective about acting, but it is the rear of a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: To claw back is to recover money or ground with effort, often tax previously paid out.

clue.text: Crafty means of removing water from the bottom of rubbish footwear

definitions.text: Crafty means of removing water from the bottom

parts.note: bilge is slang for nonsense or rubbish
a pump is a light plimsoll or dance shoe

explanation.surface: A cunning way of draining water from the soles of worthless shoes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crafty' means belonging to a craft, a boat, not cunning.
explanation.definitionFit: A bilge pump drains water from the lowest inner part of a boat's hull.

clue.text: Expressive English and Latin quote about new inside

indicators.note: the new letter is placed inside the rearranged quote
about signals that the letters are turned around and reordered

explanation.surface: An expressive passage of English and Latin quoted about something new.
explanation.definitionFit: Eloquent speech is fluent and persuasive, so it is expressive.

clue.text: Corporate fling? Unruly mob, sadly

indicators.note: an unruly crowd is disordered, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A company's office party affair upsets a rowdy crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Corporate' means of the body, and 'fling' means throw, not a romance.
explanation.definitionFit: A body slam is a wrestling move throwing an opponent down on their back, so a bodily fling.

clue.text: See 13
Boost Duke's broadcast

indicators.note: a broadcast is heard, so the name is taken by its spoken sound

parts.note: Prince Philip was the Duke of Edinburgh; the apostrophe-s is a link

explanation.surface: A royal duke's broadcast gives everyone a lift.
explanation.definitionFit: A fillip is a stimulus or encouragement, something that gives a boost.

clue.text: Parking, about to be doubled, is quite haphazard: it must come first

parts.note: P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

indicators.note: doubled means the word for about appears twice

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: haphazard means random, so the letters fall in any order

explanation.surface: Parking rules are about to be doubled, quite randomly, and come first.
explanation.definitionFit: A prerequisite is a condition that must be satisfied before something else can happen.

clue.text: American insect's joint end

definitions.meaning: in American slang a ... is a cockroach
the butt of a cannabis cigarette is called a ...

explanation.surface: An American bug owns the tip of a joint.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is US slang both for a cockroach and for the stub of a cannabis joint.

clue.text: See 13
A way to end a driver's career

definitions.text: A way to end a driver's career

parts.words: A way to end a driver's career
parts.note: career here is the verb sense, rushing out of control

explanation.surface: Something that finishes a racing driver's working life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'career' looks like a working life, but it means a car's headlong rush out of control.
explanation.definitionFit: An escape road is a run-off lane on a racing circuit or steep hill where an out-of-control car can stop safely.

clue.text: A dictum formulated to include line of Jewish legal code

indicators.note: the rearranged letters take in the line letter
formulated means put together in a new form

explanation.surface: A legal maxim drafted to include a line of Jewish law.
explanation.definitionFit: The Talmud is the body of Jewish civil and religious law, so its adjective means of that code.

clue.text: Smallholder (separated) abandoned hope etc around the end of August

indicators.note: the rearranged letters sit around the final letter
abandoned means wild and unrestrained, so the letters run riot
the end of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A separated small farmer gave up hope at the end of August.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as 'small holder', the definition is a little bag, not a farmer.
explanation.definitionFit: A pochette is a small handbag or envelope-shaped purse, literally a small holder.

clue.text: Father, look at the funny sailor!

parts.note: pop is informal for father
to eye is to look at

explanation.surface: Dad, watch the comical sailor!
explanation.definitionFit: Popeye is the spinach-eating sailor of comic strips and cartoons, so a funny sailor.
